In Chilliwack Proper South, the 55+ homes you can buy are Cottage Grove (strata). This page names each building, says what type it is and what the sources show, and covers local rules and the questions buyers ask. Anything no source states is marked unconfirmed.
55+ strata buildings you can buy in Chilliwack Proper South
Cottage Grove — 8500 Young Road (south end of Young Road / Sardis side; board feed label: Chilliwack Proper South)

Gated 55+ rancher community, built 1989 in the listing checked; listings record "Senior Community: Yes," and the Chilliwack Proper South page's own feed describes a detached rancher-style unit in a 55+ gated community at this address as part of Cottage Grove. Count it as this page's one verified 55+ ownership complex, with that flag attached.
Streets, schools and getting around Chilliwack Proper South

items.t: Chilliwack is a Chilliwack and District Real Estate Board (CADREB) market, not a Fraser Valley or Greater Vancouver board market; CADREB's own territory description covers a regional area from Yarrow to Lytton including Chilliwack, and CADREB publishes statistics board-wide only, with no sub-area tables — and SnapStats does not cover Chilliwack, so no market figures are stated for this area in this file: UNVERIFIED, and no other board's figures are substituted.
Municipality: City of Chilliwack, BC. The current city-wide plan is the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan, Bylaw 2025, No. 5500.

Working corridors, from the live page: Yale Road, Nowell Street, Spadina Avenue, Chilliwack Central Road and Young Road north of Highway 1. The page describes detached single-family homes on 6,000+ sq ft lots, updated rancher and split-level homes, townhome complexes, low-rise apartment condos and infill subdivision lots — the lot-size figure is the page's description, not an official-source statistic: UNVERIFIED as a measured profile. Treat the corridors as the page's working scope only.
The feed was more attached-heavy than the page's detached-led description suggests.
Nearby areas, per the live pages: Chilliwack Proper East and Chilliwack Proper West on the same city-proper side, Fairfield Island to the north, and Sardis / Vedder Crossing south of Highway 1.

Anchor institution: Chilliwack General Hospital, 45600 Menholm Road, is the community hospital for the city, providing primary, core secondary and some specialty services — it sits on the west / downtown side, a short distance from this scope's corridors rather than inside them.

Schools are SD33 (Chilliwack): nineteen elementary schools (K–5), four middle schools (Grades 6–8), two K–8 schools and five secondary schools (Grades 9–12). Catchments are address-based — the district directs families to its School Locator — and no locator result was run for a Proper South address in this research: address-level catchments UNVERIFIED.
Route 66 itself is confirmed on BC Transit's interregional routes page as serving Chilliwack, Abbotsford, Langley and Burnaby with daily service.

Where Chilliwack's other verified 55+ housing sits, for contrast: the Spadina Avenue pair downtown, Mountainview Estates in Proper East, Knight Lodge in Sardis West Vedder, and Cottonwood Village park on Evans Road — listed at the end of so they are not mistaken for Proper South stock.

blocks.text: Local rules and plans in Chilliwack Proper South

items.t: City zoning: Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000: is Chilliwack's zoning bylaw. Its defines a secondary suite as an accessory dwelling unit with a gross floor area of not more than 90 m² and less than 40% of the habitable floor space of the building, located within a building containing only 1 principal dwelling unit — the cap is the lesser of 90 m² and 40%.

Suites policy: the City's Secondary Suites Policy permits the rental of secondary suites within any single detached dwelling in the City regardless of zone; a suite must be built with a building permit, meet the BC Building and Fire Code and current flood protection requirements, and new secondary suites are not permitted below the flood construction level under the Floodplain Regulation Bylaw.

SSMUH: Zoning Bylaw Amendment Bylaw 2024, No. 5395 is the City's small-scale multi-unit housing amendment to Bylaw No. 5000, allowing 3 to 4 dwelling units on parcels within the urban growth boundary zoned for single-detached and duplex housing; Bylaw 5395 was adopted June 18, 2024.
Short-term rentals: the City regulates short-term rental operations under Short-Term Rental Bylaw 2021, No. 5141.
City plan: Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan, Bylaw 2025, No. 5500: is the current city-wide plan (cross-file confirmation against the City's OCP page —).

Flood: flood hazard zoning exists in the bylaw structure (RS-FHA reserve zone, Section 12 of Bylaw No. 5000) and the City applies flood protection requirements and a Floodplain Regulation Bylaw; parcel-level Flood Construction Levels for Proper South lots: UNVERIFIED.

Property taxes: City of Chilliwack property tax notices are mailed annually at the end of May and are due the first working day after July 1 of every calendar year; a 5% late payment penalty is applied for taxes outstanding after July 2, 2026 and an additional 5% for taxes outstanding after August 4, 2026.

items.t: This page's one 55+ complex does not fit this page's own map. Cottage Grove (8500 Young Rd) is claimed by the Proper South feed, assigned to the Proper South side by the sibling files, and described in listings as a gated 55+ rancher community — while the page's scope text puts Proper South north of Highway 1 and Sardis south of it, and 8500 Young is the south end of the road. The label and the geography disagree, in the file, on purpose.

Two Proper pages claim the same street, and the board claims a third name for it. Spadina Avenue is a named corridor in both the Proper South and the Proper West working scopes, while board data labels both Spadina 55+ buildings "Chilliwack Downtown." A buyer who searches by sub-area label alone will either miss the buildings or find them counted under a different Proper page.
This page's copy substantially overlaps its sibling page.
The page's feed contradicts its own board attribution.

A care residence and the 55+ ranchers share the south end of the same road. Waverly Seniors Village (8445 Young Rd, registered assisted living) and Cottage Grove (8500 Young Rd, strata ownership) sit a few civic numbers apart — two seniors products with nothing in common legally: one is a tenancy in a care residence, the other is a strata purchase governed by a 55+ bylaw.
The detached-led description is not what the feed sells. A 55+ buyer landing here is mostly looking at condo stock that is not age-restricted, plus the one flagged rancher complex.

faq.q: What 55+ homes can I actually BUY in Chilliwack Proper South?
faq.a: One verified age-restricted ownership complex, with a boundary flag: Cottage Grove (8500 Young Rd — gated ranchers, built 1989 in the listing checked, "Senior Community: Yes" in listings), which this page's feed labels Chilliwack Proper South even though the address is at the south end of Young Road on the Sardis side. No verified 55+ condo building inside the page's north-of-Highway-1 corridors was found — the Spadina condo pair is counted on the Proper West / city-wide files, not here.

faq.q: Is Cottage Grove really in Chilliwack Proper South?
faq.a: By board feed label, yes — its unit appeared in this page's feed under "Chilliwack Proper South." By the page's own geography, no — the scope is described as Young Road north of Highway 1, distinct from Sardis south of Highway 1, and 8500 Young Road is the south end of the road. The conflict is flagged in this file rather than resolved; buy the complex for what and where it is, not for the sub-area label.

faq.q: Can a detached house here take a suite or a coach house for a caregiver or family?
faq.a: One accessory dwelling unit per lot where the zone permits it — a secondary suite (capped at the lesser of 90 m² and 40% of the building's habitable floor space), a coach house, or a garden suite (capped at 100 m²) — under Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000, ss. 2 and 4.06; the City's policy also permits renting a secondary suite in any single detached dwelling regardless of zone, with a building permit and flood-protection compliance, and no new suite below the flood construction level.

faq.q: If I need help later, can I stay in this part of Chilliwack?
faq.a: Not inside this scope — no care residence or subsidized seniors building was verified on the Proper South corridors. The ladder is a move within the city: independent strata here or downtown → subsidized independent rental (Jubilee Place, 45440 Hodgins Ave, 36 units, 55+ low-income) → retirement rental and registered assisted living in the hospital precinct (the Chartwell residences and The Cascades) — plus Waverly Seniors Village, a registered assisted-living residence at 8445 Young Rd, close to Cottage Grove at the south end of Young Road.

faq.q: Is there a bus I can rely on if I stop driving?
faq.a: Route 66 Fraser Valley Express itself is confirmed as daily service between Chilliwack, Abbotsford, Langley and Burnaby.

faq.q: Why are there no market numbers for this area?
faq.a: Chilliwack is a CADREB market that SnapStats does not cover, and CADREB publishes statistics board-wide only with no sub-area tables — so any Chilliwack Proper South statistic is UNVERIFIED here rather than borrowed from a neighbouring board.

faq.q: When are Chilliwack property taxes due, and what is the penalty?
faq.a: Notices are mailed at the end of May and taxes are due the first working day after July 1 each year; for 2026, a 5% penalty applies to taxes outstanding after July 2, 2026 and an additional 5% to taxes outstanding after August 4, 2026.
